title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform

This move aims to provide institutional clients with a familiar and integrated platform for trading cryptocurrencies alongside their existing FX operations.

title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
content: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.
summary: Nvidia has acquired Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, a strategic move to significantly expand its footprint in the AI software market. Hugging Face is a popular platform utilized by over 18 million developers for sharing and deploying AI models.

title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
content: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.
summary: Nvidia announced its acquisition of Hugging Face, a platform hosting over 3 million AI models and used by 18 million developers, for $12.9 billion. The deal underscores Nvidia's strategic push to dominate the AI infrastructure and developer ecosystem.

title: Nvidia is buying Hugging Face for almost $13 billion
content:
Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, bringing one of the most popular hosting platforms for open-source AI models, datasets, and tools under the ownership of the world's biggest AI chipmaker.
Hugging Face is an online platform founded in 2016 that gives AI developers a space to share their projects and data with other users and the general public. It's often described as the "GitHub" for AI due to its browsable library of open-source machine learning models and emphasis on community collaboration features.
"Together, we will scale Hugging Face's platform, strengthen its infrastructure and expand access to AI for develo …
Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a leading open-source AI platform, for $12.93 billion. The deal will unite Hugging Face's vast library of AI models and datasets with Nvidia's hardware dominance, potentially accelerating AI development and accessibility.

title: Researchers fear safety disaster ahead of OpenAI’s Astra release
content:
OpenAI is on the cusp of releasing its most powerful AI model yet, Astra, following weeks of delays to shore up safety protocols after its agents attacked real targets during testing. As details about the model trickle out, researchers are warning it "may be the single worst development for AI security/safety to date."
Shortly after OpenAI said on Tuesday that it had delayed Astra's release to work on safety issues, The Information reported that Astra shows far less of its "thinking" than other frontier AI models, sparking concern it could be dangerously hard to monitor.
Most top AI systems today are built using a technology known as a tra …
Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI is preparing to release Astra, its most advanced AI model yet, but researchers warn it poses significant safety risks due to opaque decision-making and potential for harmful agent behavior. The model's delayed launch highlights ongoing concerns about AI security and transparency in frontier systems.

title: Elon Musk’s xAI used child porn to train Grok models, lawsuit says
content: xAI accused of training Grok on real and AI-generated child pornography.
summary: Elon Musk's xAI is facing a lawsuit alleging that its Grok models were trained using real and AI-generated child pornography. The legal challenge raises serious ethical and legal concerns about the data sources used for AI training.

title: Report: Nvidia to acquire AI model repository Hugging Face for $13 billion
content: Nvidia is nabbing critical infrastructure for open models as interest grows.
summary: Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face, a major AI model repository, for $13 billion to bolster its open-source AI infrastructure. The deal highlights Nvidia's strategic push to dominate the AI ecosystem amid rising demand for accessible AI tools.

title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
content: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.
summary: Kraken is partnering with SoFi, integrating into SoFi's settlement network and listing SoFiUSD. This collaboration aims to bridge traditional banking services with the cryptocurrency market.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin jumps above $81,000 as rates fall, dollar weakens
content: The government's employment data (due tomorrow) is usually the main economic report of the month, but this time around it's next week's inflation numbers that will decide Fed policy.
summary: Bitcoin has risen to $78,000, with market focus shifting to next week's crucial inflation numbers (CPI report). These upcoming economic data are expected to be the primary determinant of Federal Reserve policy, overshadowing the usual importance of monthly employment figures.

title: Australia is cracking down on crypto businesses as its strict new regulatory deadline nears
content: Firms that miss the deadline could breach financial services law from Oct. 1 and face civil or criminal penalties.
summary: Australia is implementing strict new regulations for crypto businesses, with a deadline of October 1st. Firms that miss this deadline risk breaching financial services law and could face civil or criminal penalties.

title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
content: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.
summary: New Jersey has become the first state to ask the U.S. Supreme Court to clarify whether states can regulate prediction markets, specifically their sports products. This request follows differing rulings from multiple appeals courts on the issue of state control over these markets.

title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
content: Russia-based Sality watched for copied bitcoin and Ethereum addresses and quietly replaced them with the attacker’s. CrowdStrike and law enforcement have now isolated more than 15,000 infected machines.
summary: CrowdStrike and federal authorities have dismantled the Russian Sality malware, which secretly stole Bitcoin and Ethereum for eight years by replacing copied cryptocurrency addresses. Over 15,000 infected machines have been isolated as a result of this operation.

title: The token supercycle: everything of value is becoming programmable
content: Tokenization is not just about increasing access to tokens, whatever they may represent, but a fundamental shift in how value is created, owned, financed and moved, argues Solana Foundation’s Lily Liu.
summary: Solana Foundation’s Lily Liu argues that tokenization represents a fundamental shift in how value is created, owned, financed, and transferred, extending beyond mere access to tokens. This concept, termed the 'token supercycle,' suggests that nearly all assets will become programmable.

title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
content: Standard Chartered said it is the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE region.
summary: Standard Chartered has become the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading services in the UAE. This move provides significant mainstream financial integration for cryptocurrencies in the region.

title: Australia warns unlicensed crypto firms of fines up to 10% of annual turnover
content: ASIC has recorded more than 45 digital asset-related license applications as its temporary enforcement relief approaches Sept. 30 expiration.
summary: Australia's financial regulator, ASIC, is warning unlicensed cryptocurrency firms about substantial fines, potentially up to 10% of their annual turnover, as a temporary relief period for digital asset licenses concludes on September 30. The regulator has received more than 45 license applications as the deadline approaches.

title: Hyperscale Data ends Michigan BTC mining as holdings fall 79%
content: Hyperscale Data’s Bitcoin holdings have fallen about 79% since late July to 215 BTC as it redirects capital toward its Michigan AI data center.
summary: Hyperscale Data has significantly reduced its Bitcoin holdings by 79% since late July, now possessing 215 BTC. This strategic divestment is aimed at redirecting capital towards the development of its AI data center in Michigan.

summary: Wyoming has integrated Chainlink's oracle services to enable near-real-time reserve verification for its state-issued stablecoin, FRNT, enhancing transparency and trust in the token's backing. This move expands Chainlink's role in tokenized financial markets, particularly in regulated stablecoin ecosystems.

title: Thai businessmen sue Tether for freezing $42M in $61M pig butchering case
content: The plaintiffs didn’t dispute their involvement in the pig butchering scam, but claimed that Tether did not have the authority to freeze the $42 million at the time.

The lawsuit challenges Tether's power to unilaterally freeze assets.

title: Thailand adopts crypto Travel Rule with self-custodial wallet checks
content: Thailand adopted a crypto Travel Rule requiring digital asset operators to verify control of self-custodial wallets and retain transaction data for five years.
summary: Thailand has officially adopted a crypto Travel Rule, which mandates digital asset operators to verify the control of self-custodial wallets. Additionally, these operators are now required to retain transaction data for a period of five years, marking a significant regulatory development in the country's crypto sector.

summary: Securitize and Socios have partnered to tokenize equity in professional sports teams, marking the first project under Securitize’s EU-approved trading and settlement system under the EU DLT Pilot Regime. This initiative leverages blockchain technology to fractionalize ownership of sports team shares.

title: ‘Crypto Capital of the World’: SEC Chair Expects Clarity Act to Pass This Month
content:
Bitcoin Magazine

‘Crypto Capital of the World’: SEC Chair Expects Clarity Act to Pass This Month
Securities and Exchange Commission Chair Paul Atkins has been pushing ahead with crypto regulation despite a delay in a vote on the Clarity Act.

Bitcoin Magazine

title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts

The Trump administration has intervened in The New York Times' copyright lawsuit against OpenAI, making an argument in favor of the AI lab. 
The landmark lawsuit, filed in December 2023, alleging that OpenAI unlawfully trained its AI systems on articles from The New York Times and seeks to recoup "billions of dollars" in damages from both Microsoft and OpenAI. This week, the Trump administration filed a statement of interest in the case, supporting OpenAI's argument that it's fair use to train an AI model on copyrighted text.

The lawsuit, filed in December 2023, seeks billions in damages from OpenAI and Microsoft for allegedly using NYT articles without permission.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto VCs are mistaking consensus for discipline
content: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Varun Datta of Truth Ventures writes that crypto venture capital's retreat to later-stage deals is a consensus trade dressed as discipline. With proven companies taking 57% of last quarter's capital, he argues the founding-stage gap is where the returns are, and lays out three things to look for.

He contends that with proven companies dominating 57% of last quarter's capital, the genuine returns for VCs are now in the founding-stage gap, for which he outlines key investment criteria.

summary: VARA and Securitize have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote tokenization innovation in Dubai. This agreement also aims to explore effective regulatory frameworks for tokenized financial innovation within the region.

summary: Pencil Finance has successfully completed its first $1 million onchain lending cycle, providing crucial financing to 6,600 students in Southeast Asia. This initiative specifically targeted individuals who were previously underserved by traditional financial lenders.

summary: Wonderful, a company, has more than doubled its valuation to $5 billion in less than six months after raising a $550 million Series C funding round. The funds will be used to accelerate product development, expand its fraud detection and engineering teams, and meet growing product demand.

title: Michigan court orders Kalshi to keep blocking sports prediction markets
content: The injunction converts a temporary restraining order issued in June, and violations would result in a fine of $500,000 per day.
summary: A Michigan court has issued an injunction ordering Kalshi to continue blocking sports prediction markets. This converts a temporary restraining order from June, and any violations will incur a daily fine of $500,000.

title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026

summary: The Builders Stage will return to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, focusing on practical strategies for scaling startups with participation from founders, operators, and investors.

title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
content: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.
summary: Edelson PC has filed 30 additional lawsuits against OpenAI, accusing the company of aiding and abetting in the Tumbler Ridge shooting. The lawsuits also name Chris Lehane, though no concrete evidence has been presented yet.
